title: Older drivers, riders and road users
summary: Find out about the medical assessments, tests, and requirements for older drivers and riders in NSW.
intro:
If you intend to continue driving or riding after you turn 70 there are driver, rider and medical tests you need to know about.

For advice and safety tips to make safer choices as an older driver or rider visit the NSW Centre for Road Safety website – The Road Ahead.

### Driver or rider licence holders

From 75 years of age you should receive a letter by post from Transport for NSW 8 weeks before your birthday. The medical assessment and driving test (if applicable) must be completed before your birthday.
who_can_apply: Individuals who intend to continue driving or riding after turning 70.
Driver or rider licence holders aged 70 to 74 years.
Driver or rider licence holders aged 75 years and over.
Driver or rider licence holders aged 85 years and over.
what_you_need: From 70 to 74 years of age, you do not need a medical assessment or driving test unless a doctor recommends it, unless you have a heavy vehicle licence.
From 75 years of age, you need to have a medical assessment for Fitness to Drive each year to keep an unrestricted driver (class C) or rider (class R) licence.
From 85 years of age, you need to pass a practical on-road driving or riding assessment, and then take a practical assessment every 2 years.
To find out about fees for licences, tests, handbooks and mobility parking permits, visit the Driver and rider licence fees page.

faqs.q: When do I need to start worrying about medical assessments for my licence?
faqs.a: From 75 years of age, you must complete a medical assessment for Fitness to Drive each year to keep an unrestricted driver (class C) or rider (class R) licence.

faqs.q: What do I need to do if I am 85 years old?
faqs.a: In addition to the yearly medical assessment, you must pass a practical on-road driving or riding assessment. After that, you need to take a practical assessment every 2 years.

faqs.q: How many attempts do I get to pass the driving or riding test?
faqs.a: You can have up to 3 attempts to pass your driving test, but there is no limit to the number of attempts to pass your driving test.
